lines.beaver: 이번 주말에 자연 보러 가고 싶어. 어디 좋아?
lines.beaver_en: I want to see some nature this weekend. Where's good?
lines.beaver_roman: ibeon jumare jayeon boreo gago sipeo. eodi joa?
lines.learner: 설악산 계곡이 가 볼 만해. 물이 정말 맑아.
lines.en: The valley at Seoraksan is worth visiting. The water is really clear.
lines.roman: seoraksan gyegogi ga bol manhae. muri jeongmal malga.

lines.beaver: 계곡 좋다! 거기 또 뭐가 있어?
lines.beaver_en: A valley sounds great! What else is there?
lines.beaver_roman: gyegok jota! geogi tto mwoga isseo?
lines.learner: 큰 바위도 많고 숲도 넓어. 걸을 만해.
lines.en: There are lots of big rocks and a wide forest. It's worth walking.
lines.roman: keun bawido manko supdo neolbeo. georeul manhae.

lines.learner: 별로 안 힘들어. 천천히 걸으면 돼.
lines.en: Not really. You just walk slowly.
lines.roman: byeollo an himdeureo. cheoncheonhi georeumyeon dwae.

lines.beaver_en: What about the sea? I want to see it too.
lines.learner: 속초 바다가 가까워. 파도 소리가 멋져.
lines.en: The Sokcho sea is close. The sound of the waves is great.
lines.roman: sokcho badaga gakkawo. pado soriga meotjyeo.

lines.beaver_en: Is it good to go with kids?
lines.learner: 응, 바닷가 옆에 잔디밭이 있어서 좋아.
lines.en: Yes, there's a lawn next to the beach, so it's good.
lines.roman: eung, badatga yeope jandibachi isseoseo joa.

lines.beaver_en: What can you do on the lawn?
lines.learner: 돗자리 펴고 쉬기 좋아. 하루 놀 만해.
lines.en: It's good for resting on a mat. It's worth a day of fun.
lines.roman: dotjari pyeogo swigi joa. haru nol manhae.

lines.beaver_en: Is there anything else worth seeing?
lines.learner: 산 근처에 오래된 우물도 있어. 볼 만해.
lines.en: There's also an old well near the mountain. It's worth seeing.
lines.roman: san geuncheoe oraedoen umuldo isseo. bol manhae.

lines.beaver: 우물? 신기하다. 물도 마실 수 있어?
lines.beaver_en: A well? Interesting. Can you drink the water?
lines.beaver_roman: umul? singihada. muldo masil su isseo?
lines.learner: 지금은 못 마셔. 그래도 구경할 만해.
lines.en: You can't drink it now. But it's still worth a look.
lines.roman: jigeumeun mot masyeo. geuraedo gugyeonghal manhae.

lines.beaver_en: Is it easy to get train tickets?
lines.en: They sell out fast on weekends. Book early.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks! I'll show you photos when I'm back.
